systemd.name: sync-weather
systemd.unit:
[Unit]
Description=Run the job 'sync-weather'

[Service]
ExecStart={PYTHON} -m meerschaum sync pipes -c plugin:noaa --loop --min-seconds 3600
KillSignal=SIGTERM
Restart=always
RestartPreventExitStatus=0
SyslogIdentifier=mrsm-sync-weather.service
Environment=MRSM_ROOT_DIR={TMP}/root
Environment=MRSM_PLUGINS_DIR={TMP}/plugins
Environment=MRSM_VENVS_DIR={TMP}/venvs
Environment=MRSM_NO_AUTO_INSTALL=1
Environment=MRSM_DAEMON_ID=sync-weather
Environment=MRSM_SYSTEMD_LOG_PATH={TMP}/root/systemd/logs/mrsm-sync-weather.service.log
Environment=MRSM_SYSTEMD_RESULT_PATH={TMP}/root/systemd/services/sync-weather/mrsm-sync-weather.service.result.json
Environment=MRSM_SYSTEMD_STDIN_PATH={TMP}/root/systemd/services/sync-weather/mrsm-sync-weather.service.stdin
Environment=MRSM_SYSTEMD_DELETE_JOB=0
Environment=PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1
Environment=LINES=40
Environment=COLUMNS=70
Environment=MRSM_NONINTERACTIVE=true

[Install]
WantedBy=default.target

systemd.name: my job
systemd.unit:
[Unit]
Description=Run the job 'my job'

[Service]
ExecStart={PYTHON} -m meerschaum show version --nopretty
KillSignal=SIGTERM
Restart=always
RestartPreventExitStatus=0
SyslogIdentifier=mrsm-my-job.service
Environment=MRSM_ROOT_DIR={TMP}/root
Environment=MRSM_PLUGINS_DIR={TMP}/plugins
Environment=MRSM_VENVS_DIR={TMP}/venvs
Environment=MRSM_NO_AUTO_INSTALL=1
Environment=MRSM_DAEMON_ID='my job'
Environment=MRSM_SYSTEMD_LOG_PATH={TMP}/root/systemd/logs/mrsm-my-job.service.log
Environment=MRSM_SYSTEMD_RESULT_PATH='{TMP}/root/systemd/services/my job/mrsm-my-job.service.result.json'
Environment=MRSM_SYSTEMD_STDIN_PATH='{TMP}/root/systemd/services/my job/mrsm-my-job.service.stdin'
Environment=MRSM_SYSTEMD_DELETE_JOB=0
Environment=PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1
Environment=LINES=40
Environment=COLUMNS=70
Environment=MRSM_NONINTERACTIVE=true
Environment=FOO='bar baz'
Environment=QUOTE='it'"'"'s'

[Install]
WantedBy=default.target
systemd.socket:
[Unit]
BindsTo=mrsm-my-job.service

[Socket]
ListenFIFO={TMP}/root/systemd/services/my job/mrsm-my-job.service.stdin
FileDescriptorName=stdin
RemoveOnStop=true
SocketMode=0660
